purpose.summary: Extend the existing upstream plugin metadata loader to bounded multiple identifiers while preserving legacy bytes and once-per-matching-plugin dispatch.
scope: Direct child of the exact signed public main871987b integrated by PR66; no private history or incoming proof.
Accept one four-byte bytes identifier or a list of1..32unique four-byte bytes identifiers; preserve order and reject invalid width,type,count or duplicates.
Reuse the existing upstream PluginContext,dispatch,indexer,ALP and plugin-output machinery; no replacement engine.
Preserve plugin construction,inheritance/version checks and the original MIT notices; the changed loader is an authored adaptation,not an unchanged donor file.
Bind both metadata-loader files into the optional adapter identity; add a test-only Cargo example without registry/dependency or daemon admission changes.
Compute that exact ordered plugin input identity in both CMake and the inherited runner;compare their complete five-input lists in a regression test without bypassing build binding.
Exercise11Rust metadata unit cases and6synthetic transactions through the real upstream context;require combined identifiers to dispatch one instance exactly once.
Mount the existing logger API only in the standalone synthetic example;capture and verify exactly three bounded setup messages before requiring the unchanged single stdout marker and empty stderr.
Retain every inherited native case,assertion,repetition,deadline,cleanup and daemon scenario;all seven existing CI jobs remain required.
Finite successor policy binds the exact current postimages while retaining immutable earlier manifests and original public donor preimages.
exclusions: No consensus,activation,network identity,native admission,token-validation algorithm,index schema or default-ON behavior.
No deployment,cutover,release,desktop integration,dependency-alert suppression or automatic proof promotion.
